name: Anukriti Tyagi
details: I had been insecure about my smile for years and kept putting off treatment. Dr. Shruti Malik changed that completely. She took the time to understand exactly what I wanted, explained every step clearly, and the result is beyond what I imagined. My friends cannot stop complimenting my smile. The clinic is spotless and everyone on the team made me feel completely at ease. Genuinely life-changing experience.

name: B.K. Sharma
details: At my age I wasn't sure cosmetic dental work was worth it, but my family convinced me to visit Dr. Shruti. I'm so glad they did. The treatment was comfortable, the results were visible almost immediately, and she never pressured me into anything I wasn't sure about. Honest, expert advice and a caring approach — exactly what you want from a doctor. Will recommend to everyone I know.

name: Roop Kishore
details: The transformation in my smile is something I still can't believe when I look in the mirror. Dr. Shruti Malik is extraordinarily skilled — she has an eye for detail that shows in the final result. The entire process from consultation to completion was smooth and well-explained. The staff is warm and the clinic feels premium yet approachable. Radix Cosmo Dental is my family's dental home now.

name: Priya Sharma
details: I'd been dreading my root canal for months. Dr. Shruti made the whole thing so easy — I honestly felt no pain and was eating normally the next day. She explained every step before doing it, which really settled my nerves. Her expertise as an Endodontist is evident the moment she starts working. Best dental experience I've ever had.

name: Rohit Verma
details: Got a dental implant here after losing a molar. Dr. Shruti walked me through every option, the cost, and the recovery with complete transparency — no upselling, just honest advice. The implant feels exactly like a real tooth now. The clinic is immaculate and the entire team is genuinely warm and professional.

name: Neha Gupta
details: Started my Invisalign journey here six months ago and the progress is already incredible. Dr. Malik is patient with every question and the check-ups are quick and efficient. I love that she shows me progress photos at every visit so I can see the improvement for myself. Best investment I've made for my confidence this year.

name: Megha Khanna
details: Brought my 6-year-old for her first dental visit and she actually enjoyed it! Dr. Shruti is so gentle and patient with children — she explained everything like it was a fun game. My daughter now reminds me about her next appointment. If you're looking for a kids' dentist in East Delhi, look no further than Radix Cosmo Dental.

name: Aman Singh
details: Had scaling, polishing and whitening done together in one visit. The difference in my smile is genuinely night and day — friends keep asking what changed. Pricing was completely transparent, no surprises at billing. The clinic is modern, hygienic and the staff made me feel comfortable throughout. Will be coming back every six months without fail.

name: Rahul Mehta
details: Came in with severe tooth sensitivity that two other dentists had failed to diagnose correctly. Dr. Malik identified the root cause on the very first visit and the treatment plan was spot on. Within a week the sensitivity was completely gone. Her depth of knowledge as a specialist Endodontist really shows. This is the only clinic I trust for complex dental issues.
